rationale: Protein language-model embedding of the sequence; fully computable for any novel target. Largest single lift (+0.059). PCA-32 fit in-fold to avoid embedding leakage.
Sequence-, constraint-, and brain-expression-derived (UniProt/InterPro/gnomAD/GTEx/HPA). All available at target-discovery time. The frozen cold-start baseline (0.700) is built on these alone.
GO terms PREDICTED from sequence-derived InterPro domains — distinct from CURATED GO (which accrues with study and would leak). Cold-start safe by construction.
Descriptors of the sequence-predicted structure; available for any protein with a sequence. +0.026 standalone.
Sequence homology to known targets; label-free. +0.014. NB: also used to build the homolog-safe fold, so evaluate with fold_seqclust.
Within-family aggregates of intrinsic properties. Redundant with ESMC-6B+GO+structure (±0.002 on the full stack) — dropped from the canonical set; kept in v3 lineage.
Aggregates keyed on disease. Give +0.058 CROSS-disease but only +0.005 WITHIN-disease — a disease-knowledge prior, not a target discriminator. Demoted per the anti-waste principle.
Disease crowding correlates -0.54 with success; gene track-record +0.50 but is survivorship (~0 for a novel target). A tool that followed the crowd has no counterfactual value (anti-waste objective).
The outcome itself: label_consensus, label_tier, src_* etc.
Computed from what happened AFTER the decision: max_phase_reached, ctgov_n_failed_trials, tgt_other_failures, dis_other_fail_rate, moa_confirmed, ...
Evidence that accrues as a target is pursued: first_year, total_evidence, recent_evidence.
Exist BECAUSE someone already invested: n_ligands, has_ligand, is_ligandable, sm_tractable, chem_n_compounds, ...
Open Targets association scores; present mostly for already-studied targets (missing-not-at-random). Down-weighted; adds ±0.0003 on the fair set.
Genetic-causality and functional evidence; the causal arm of the causal-vs-association test. Coverage uneven across CNS areas.
